intro: The Orth coffee table brings calm to busy spaces. Clean lines, generous storage, and a durable top offer a sleek solution for your living room—so you can focus on relaxing, not clutter.

features.title: Simple design that just works
features.text: Minimalist lines, maximum impact—our modern design adds style without overwhelming your space.

features.title: Dual-tone finish warms up your space
features.text: Modern appeal meets function with Sonoma Oak and Greystone Dark tones that elevate any contemporary interior.

features.title: Keep items handy with shelf storage
features.text: Reach for your favourite book with ease! Our design, complete with an accessible lower shelf, keeps essentials close without crowding your space.

features.title: Toughened glass top for added safety
features.text: Our crystal-clear 8mm glass top offers lasting strength while letting your décor shine through beautifully.

features.title: Wall-friendly design for flexible spaces
features.text: Create a flexible, inviting space with our versatile design. Whether nestled between sofas or styled against a wall, it blends seamlessly into your living area.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
